You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 28cfeed4c1a07262ac9d0abc4e9263f10971633a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marcin Bukat <marcin.bukat@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2018 21:17:08 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] Agptek Rocker: Add missing lcd_set_active(true) in
 lcd_init_device()

This should fix problem introduced in 5c015ad resulting
in not updating screen properly in wps.

Change-Id: Ie36b6edfcfc7d425c84381402adae79d77fcc92f
---
 firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-agptek.c | 4 ++++
 firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-target.h | 2 ++
 2 files changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-agptek.c b/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-agptek.c
index ff5a8146a2..4b3148da03 100644
--- a/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-agptek.c
+++ b/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-agptek.c
@@ -74,6 +74,10 @@ void lcd_init_device(void)
     {
         panicf("Cannot map framebuffer");
     }
+
+#ifdef HAVE_LCD_ENABLE
+    lcd_set_active(true);
+#endif
 }
 
 #ifdef HAVE_LCD_SHUTDOWN
diff --git a/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-target.h b/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-target.h
index b6fcfdb98f..f7ed743aef 100644
--- a/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-target.h
+++ b/firmware/target/hosted/agptek/lcd-target.h
@@ -27,4 +27,6 @@
 
 extern fb_data *framebuffer; /* see lcd-agptek.c */
 #define LCD_FRAMEBUF_ADDR(col, row) (framebuffer + (row)*LCD_WIDTH + (col))
+
+extern void lcd_set_active(bool active);
 #endif /* __LCD_TARGET_H__ */
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the omission of the `lcd_set_active(true)` function call in the `lcd_init_device()` function, which is necessary to properly initialize and activate the LCD screen. This oversight led to the screen not updating correctly in the user interface, particularly in the "wps" (While Playing Screen) context. The issue was introduced in a previous commit (5c015ad) that likely altered the initialization sequence or removed the activation call without providing an alternative mechanism for screen activation.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>

    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the omission of the `lcd_set_active(true)` function call in the `lcd_init_device()` function, which is necessary to properly initialize and activate the LCD screen. This oversight led to the screen not updating correctly in the user interface, particularly in the "wps" (While Playing Screen) context. The issue was introduced in a previous commit (5c015ad) that likely altered the initialization sequence or removed the activation call without providing an alternative mechanism for screen activation.
